reason: Adds a draggable Live2D desktop-pet overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with character switching, outfit selection, interactions, local position persistence, and PNG capture.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加可拖拽的 Live2D 桌宠，支持角色与换装切换、互动、位置持久化和 PNG 截图。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable Live2D desktop pet to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with character and outfit switching, interactions, position persistence, and PNG screenshots.

capabilities: Injects a draggable Live2D widget into the web interface
Serves bundled model and thumbnail assets through same-origin routes
Downloads PNG screenshots when the user takes a photo
